text: Swimming is a fun and beneficial way to stay active, and it's a great way to cool off in the hot summer sun. Swimming laps or in the pool is easy and quick to learn. However, swimming without goggles can cause serious eye injuries. It's important to wear goggles to protect your eyes from harmful UV rays and to prevent eye irritation. Always warm up properly before swimming, and drink plenty of water before, during, and after swimming.
